page: Microsoft Azure D8s_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dsv6 server family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating at 4.2 GHz. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include any local storage or integrated GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable for external block storage attachments.

Benchmark data shows strong single-core performance, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2162.0 and a text processing score of 2704.0, both placing in the top 25%. Multi-core and memory benchmarks generally fall within the average range, including a stress-ng multi-core score of 7990.85 and a Passmark CPU score of 14296.51. Memory read-only bandwidth reaches 621.59 GB/sec for small cached blocks and drops to 67.85 GB/sec for large uncached blocks.

The hardware supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions), which assist with vector and matrix operations. However, without a dedicated GPU, the server exhibits a performance bottleneck on larger workloads, as evidenced by a weak text generation speed of 7.94 tokens/sec on a medium 7B LLM model. This profile makes the instance suitable for general-purpose workloads, static web serving, software compilation, and database operations that do not require local NVMe storage or heavy parallel GPU acceleration.
